request.prompt: The same island town at dusk, seen from the sea just off the quay at sunset: the sun setting low over the sea on the left, warm orange and pink sky, the houses' windows and the lanterns along the quay lit, townsfolk standing on the quay with torches looking out to sea, and two dark raiders' longboats rowing in toward the harbour from the open water. The lighthouse beam is lit. Same voxel Minecraft look, the same palette under dusk light.
request.style_note: Kelderby, a cheerful harbour town on an island below a castle mountain, on the day of its yearly festival, in exactly the hand of the first picture: a path-traced Minecraft voxel world, every form built from cubic blocks with flat faces, grey stone and dark timber houses with dark slate roofs, green terraced turf, oak woods, a red-and-white striped lighthouse on its pier, a grey castle on the summit, a deep blue sea with pale turquoise shallows over sand, soft haze toward the horizon. Each image is ONE single full-frame view of that place, filling the frame edge to edge: never a sheet, never a grid, never a panel, never an inset, never a caption, label, text or border. No UI.
